LanguageData.BillAutopilot.Settings.Intro: Pick which workbench types run on autopilot. For each one, the mod keeps bills alive on its own: a bill appears when there is work to do and steps aside once it is done, so the tab stays short. Recipes unlocked later are added by themselves.
LanguageData.BillAutopilot.Settings.NotifyDesc: A recipe unlocked after a workbench was put on autopilot arrives as a suspended bill, so it never spends anything behind your back. This sends a letter listing them.
LanguageData.BillAutopilot.Settings.MaxBills: At most {0} automatic bills per workbench (the game allows {1})
LanguageData.BillAutopilot.Profile.Enabled: Autopilot on for this workbench type
LanguageData.BillAutopilot.Profile.EnabledDesc: Applies to every workbench of this kind, the ones you build later included.
LanguageData.BillAutopilot.Profile.UncountableDesc: Butchering, smelting, cremation, surgery and anything else the game cannot count: "keep in stock" is impossible for them, so they follow this setting instead.
LanguageData.BillAutopilot.Profile.UncountableRecipe: The game cannot count what this recipe produces, so it follows the setting for uncountable recipes.
LanguageData.BillAutopilot.Gizmo.ToggleDesc: Run every {0} on autopilot: bills are put up and taken down on their own, and recipes unlocked later join in.
LanguageData.BillAutopilot.Gizmo.ConfigureDesc: Set what the autopilot does on every {0}, recipe by recipe.
LanguageData.BillAutopilot.NewRecipeLetterBody: The autopilot has put these up as suspended bills. Unsuspend the ones you want; delete the ones you do not, and it will leave them alone from now on.\n\n{0}
LanguageData.BillAutopilot.DriftCaptured: {0} kept as an override on the {1} profile.
LanguageData.BillAutopilot.TemplateStripped: {0} autopilot bills were left out of the template: it keeps what you put on the bench, not what the autopilot had up at that moment.
LanguageData.BillAutopilot.RecipeExcluded: {0} will no longer be put up on a {1}.
